text: Native Windows Codex added definitive evidence to #6543: VFP retries a transient byte-range lock and returns 4 MiB; Copperfin silently returns the 3 MiB prefix with FERROR=0. Separately, I filed approved #6546 for CHRTRANC incorrectly treating ASCII matching as case-insensitive; VFP9 help explicitly says it equals CHRTRAN for single-byte text, and the public runtime differs. https://github.com/rhamenator/Project-Copperfin/issues/6546. No production edit.
